200 Returned if the Tenable MSSP Platform successfully created the account group.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string <uuid>
The UUID of the account group.
— 400
Returned if your request specified invalid parameters, if your request was improperly formatted, or if an
account group with the specified name already exists.
— 403
Returned if you do not have permissions to create an account group. For more information, see
Permissions.
— 404 Returned if the Tenable MSSP Platform could not find the specified accounts.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
500 Returned if an internal error occurred in the Tenable MSSP Portal.
